body.statement:
Consider a terminal reached by the deterministic recursion with two legal source-mass points \(\theta^-\) and \(\theta^+\) from the same explicit source-decoder instance, satisfying every stored boundary primitive-event equality,
\[
 \Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+),\qquad
 K(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)>0,
\]
and having nonzero local cross-product
\[
 \Delta=H(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)-H(\theta^+)K(\theta^-)\ne0.
\]
Must there always exist exterior source masses using only the fixed exterior source alphabets and decoder of that same explicit instance, together with a boundary assignment of positive transmitting weight, such that recursive gluing yields two global same-alphabet, same-source-incidence models agreeing on every supplied law but having unequal conditional targets?  If not, characterize the stored interfaces for which transmission is possible and give a finite source-preserving certificate that every legal exterior attachment annihilates the local contrast.
body.justification: After rational descent fails, universal nonvanishing transmission is the sole remaining recursion-specific completeness question for negative terminal certificates.
body.gap: The established boundary-interface lemma is conditional on a transmitting assignment; neither cyclic gluing results nor source-compatibility algorithms prove that such an assignment always exists.
body.consumer: A resolution would tell cfid whether every local same-source separator can be promoted to a global countermodel or whether it needs an additional finite interface-obstruction output.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove universal existence of a positive-weight transmitting boundary assignment for every legal locally separating same-instance terminal pair, or construct and characterize a finite source-preserving interface obstruction.
obligation.obstruction: The conditional gluing identity does not prevent every exterior transmission coefficient from vanishing or canceling, and the frozen recursion invariant records interface equality without a noncancellation condition.
obligation.attempted: The conditional boundary-interface identity was proved and an explicit two-district example was checked, but neither argument supplies a universal invariant over all legal exterior attachments.
obligation.partial_result: The proved conditional gluing lemma establishes the following implication: once a certificate contains a boundary assignment with nonzero transmitting weight, holding the exterior mechanisms and sources fixed preserves every supplied-law coordinate and carries a nonzero local target cross-product to unequal global conditional targets.  The missing step is existence of such an assignment for every locally separating pair.  The recursion state records complete boundary primitive-event equalities, but no frozen invariant bounds a transmitting coefficient away from zero or rules out cancellation over all legal exterior attachments.  The rational-descent issue is no longer part of this question: the algebraic-branch theorem answers that issue negatively.
